column3:
• National Protocol for the Management of Diabetes
and Hypertension at the PHC level
• Guideline for Lifecare of Hypertensive Patients
Guideline for Lifecare of Diabetic Patients
• National Guideline for Management of Stroke at the
PHC level
• National Guideline for Management of Headache at
the PHC level
• Diabetes Care – BADAS Guideline 2019, a joint
initiative of NCDC and BADAS
• National Protocol for Management of Bronchial
Asthma and COPD at the PHC level
• Prevention, Early Detection, and Management of
Non-communicable Diseases in Bangladesh.
• Develop Multisectoral Action Plan 2021-2025 on
NCDs
• National Guideline for Stroke (Bangla/English)
developed
• House-to-house active surveillance and
interpersonal communication (IPC) on the
management of major NCDs completed
• STEPS Survey 2018 was developed
• Mass awareness activities on major NCDs
(cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, COPD, cancer).
• Hypertension and diabetes screening completed at
300 upazilas
• PEN implementation model in 70 upazilas
• Delivered NCD management equipment, like ECG
machine, glucometer with stripe, weighing machine,
BP machine, stethoscope, etc. to all upazila health
complexes, community clinics, and district/sadar
hospitals
• Revised implementation strategy to facilitate NCD
screening at the community level developed
• Supplied antihypertensive and antidiabetic drugs
• Prevention and treatment guidelines on
hypertension and diabetes are separately
developed
• Continuous capacity-building, training, and seminars
going on throughout the country
